<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Mini Buu''' is a tiny, flying [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]] that roams the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]] and fires pink ki blasts. Together with Endermen, it is the planet's only hostile mob.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Mini Buu spawns in the Sacred Kai Plains, Hills and Rivers biomes (spawn weight 4, alone). It is a '''wild enemy''': it spawns under open sky, day or night, away from torches and other light. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Bestiary#How wild enemies spawn|how wild enemies spawn]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
Mini Buu flies, fights on the '''Novice''' AI tier and fires pink ki blasts.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Mini Buu drops nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== Tournaments == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
Mini Buu is one of the Buu Saga fighters that can be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]].
</translate>
